prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Conroe, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1344; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is about the collision you were involved in on the roadway in Conroe, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please state your full name and the address where you currently live.

A: I'd rather keep the personal details to what you already have on file, but I can confirm I was the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe what happened leading up to the collision?

A: I was heading north in the right lane, going maybe twenty-five miles an hour because of the traffic. The other car came over from the opposite direction and drifted into my lane. We hit nose to nose, but it wasn't a hard impact. Both cars were moving slowly.

Q: Did you have any chance to brake or steer away before the impact?

A: I hit the brakes, but there wasn't enough room. It all happened quickly.

Q: Did you lose consciousness at any point?

A: I don't think I fully blacked out, but my head hit the steering wheel and the airbag went off. Everything was fuzzy for a bit afterward.

Q: How are you feeling now?

A: I still have headaches, and bright lights bother me. I get dizzy when I stand up too fast. My doctor said I have a concussion and I need to limit screen time and rest.

Q: Have you sought any medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I was taken by ambulance to the emergency room and I've been seeing my primary care doctor since then.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just hope the other driver's insurance takes care of things.

Q: Thank you for your cooperation. This concludes the recorded statement.
